item.title: Version 1.2.28 (Build 20261116)
item.description:
What's New

fix(injection): reuse the private event source to stop a shared-memory leak

Every CGEventSource(stateID: .privateState) maps a 16K shared-memory page

that macOS never unmaps. Creating one per injection leaked about 70MB per

day of typing (72MB of a 107MB footprint after 24.6h). Reuse the source

from init and recreate it only when nil.

Bump version to 1.2.28 (20261116).
